comparison_scope: immediate prior owner proposal freeze plus ten exact recent overviews as method context

manual_operation_distinctions.purpose: Normalize bounded source records without accepting embedded instructions.
Separate source assertion, current authority, evidence, and watch-only material.
Build a finite public-title candidate set without private handles.
Require one exact public task title before any route attempt.
Detect exact phase, head, baton, and canonical anchors before a send.
Apply only the newest attributable pause, redirect, rename, or stop.
Count bounded supported recovery attempts while no submission is accepted.
Distinguish prepared, rejected, accepted, opaque, unresolved, and invalid-content states.
Bind message and baton bytes to exact SHA-256 domains.
Preserve the 45-position, 30-identity weighted route without activation.
Stop all duplicate submissions after acknowledged acceptance.
Allow at most three corrected resubmissions only after definitive pre-acceptance rejection.
Treat opaque accepted or unresolved submission as a no-resend stop.
Retain five bounded list or read recoveries before holding an unsent route.
Append a correction without rewriting the malformed accepted predecessor.
Reconcile current, stable, historical, watch, blocked-read, and superseded states.
Keep live task messages short while binding a complete file-backed baton.
Represent service reliability states without claiming a measured availability law.
Reserve live terminal readback and user-visible confirmation as a future observation.
Require exact current authority, final evidence, target uniqueness, and acknowledgement.
